title: TODO.yaml: the open items of the plan
description: Every item of work that is not done: its context as statements pinned like the README's (a test, an action or a check that would fail if the statement were false, or an explicit hypothesis), the stubs its acceptance test is written against, and the acceptance test itself, a function of harness/test_acceptance.py that must fail while the item is open and pass once it is done. harness/check_todo.py validates this schema, resolves every pin, runs every acceptance test and requires each stub to be exercised by one.

status.description: the acceptance test must fail unless the status is done, and must pass when it is

round.description: the round of work the item belongs to

context.description: prose, one statement per entry; each is pinned or a hypothesis

pinned_by.description: a test of harness/test_claims.py or harness/test_acceptance.py, an action of harness/run.py, or a static check (check_<name>)

stubs.description: classes of stubs.py the acceptance test is written against; every method of each must be exercised by the acceptance tests

touches.description: files the item is expected to change or create
